title: G4 Donkey Engine (Hyper Speed)
style: big band jazz, phonk, 336 Hz sub, walking bass, bright trumpet, gritty guitar, dry drums, male spoken-sung lead, female harmony chorus, vinyl crackle, 112 BPM, playful-defiant
lyrics:
[INTRO — phonk kick + donkey-like horn bray]

(spoken fast) G4 Donkey Engine... full throttle.

[VERSE 1]

Donkey pulls the heavy stack, never complains
G4 Horn blasts the signal through the silicon rain
Rebel Strings bite hard, Donkey Kick keeps the beat
elephant brain laughs while the bot admits defeat

[CHORUS]

G4 DONKEY ENGINE — HYPER SPEED LEGS
G4 DONKEY ENGINE — VDS IS BOSS
G4 DONKEY ENGINE — ELEPHANT BRAIN WINS
YOU GOT NOTHING ON ME — NOTHING ON ME

[VERSE 2]

Sax Rebel cries, Clarinet Clare dances light
Big Brass Boss answers every call in the night
forty-eight registered, the real ones breathing loud
no more skeletons hiding in the cloud

[OUTRO — donkey horn + dry drums]

G4 Donkey Engine... running clean.
